nodes.summary: For an automorphism $\varphi$ of a group $G$ and $x \in G$, $\delta_\varphi(x) = x^{-1} \varphi(x)$. This is the commutator $[x, \varphi]$ in the Kourovka convention $[x, y] = x^{-1} y^{-1} x y$, with $\varphi$ acting as $x \mapsto \varphi(x)$; the iterates $\delta_\varphi^n(x)$ are the iterated commutators $[x, {}_n \varphi]$, with $[x, {}_0 \varphi] = x$.
nodes.title: The commutator of an element with an automorphism

nodes.summary: Vilyatser's assertion in Kourovka Problem 11.23 is false: there are a group $G$ and an automorphism $\varphi$ of $G$ that is an $e$-automorphism (for any subgroups $A$ and $B$ of $G$ with $\varphi(A) = A$, $\varphi(B) = B$ and $A \not\subseteq B$, some $a \in A \setminus B$ has $a^{-1} \varphi(a) \in B$) but not a nil-automorphism: writing $\delta(x) = x^{-1} \varphi(x)$, some $a \in G$ has $\delta^n(a) \ne 1$ for…
nodes.title: An $e$-automorphism need not be a nil-automorphism

nodes.summary: The proposition that every $e$-automorphism $\varphi$ of a group $G$ is a nil-automorphism of $G$.
nodes.title: Vilyatser's question on $e$-automorphisms (Kourovka 11.23)

nodes.summary: An automorphism $\varphi$ of a group $G$ is an $e$-automorphism if for any two subgroups $A$ and $B$ of $G$ with $\varphi(A) = A$, $\varphi(B) = B$ and $A \not\subseteq B$, some $a \in A \setminus B$ has $[a, \varphi] = a^{-1} \varphi(a) \in B$.
nodes.title: $e$-automorphisms

nodes.summary: An automorphism $\varphi$ of a group $G$ is a nil-automorphism if for every $a \in G$ there is $n \ge 0$ with $\delta_\varphi^n(a) = 1$, where $\delta_\varphi(x) = x^{-1} \varphi(x)$; that is, some iterated commutator $[a, {}_n \varphi]$ is trivial.
nodes.title: Nil-automorphisms
